verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that source code can be browsed, edited, and downloaded via 'Download codebase', or synced to a GitHub/GitLab repo the user owns. The docs also say you can work locally in your IDE and 'deploy outside Lovable'; the Supabase-based open-source backend suggests some backend portability. Missing for 10: documented steps for self-hosting or migrating the built-in Cloud backend (database, auth, edge functions) off Lovable, a concrete run-locally/deploy-elsewhere guide, and independent hands-on corroboration that exported apps run outside the platform.
